manifest.seed: none — deterministic tokenizer counts, no sampling
manifest.prompts: none — no model is prompted; token counts only
manifest.method: tokens(ainglish) - tokens(english), averaged across six strict minimal pairs; the English arm is a concise natural rendering of all declared semantics (human judgment required, reason stated, agents must not decide); the reason slot is copied verbatim between arms. Reported value is the least favorable lineage mean. Items were authored fresh and fixed before counting; no item from the referenced original manifest is reused.
